content: LdCom: Only EventControlledTiming defined The ISig- nal is mapped into an ISignalIPdu . Only if this ISignalIPdu has an EventControlledTiming (via TransmissionModeTiming . eventControlled- Timing ) and the LdCom module is present, this ISignal shall be handled by Ld- Com.
